# Tamarind Village Mombasa

> Luxury Swahili-styled coastal serviced apartments and fine dining perched on the cliffside shores of Tudor Creek in Nyali, Mombasa, Kenya. Overlooking Mombasa Old Town and the historical harbor.

## Overview
- **Location**: Cement Silos Road, Nyali, Mombasa, Kenya (Tudor Creek waterfront).
- **Property Type**: Luxury Serviced Apartments, Oceanfront Dining, Dhow Cruises, and Event Venues.
- **Accommodations**: 1-Bedroom, 2-Bedroom, and 3-Bedroom fully serviced residences with private sea-facing verandas, modern kitchens, air conditioning, and daily housekeeping.
- **Dining**: Tamarind Mombasa Restaurant (world-renowned seafood), The Dawa Terrace (cliffside sunset cocktail lounge), and The Tamarind Dhow (sailing restaurant cruise).
- **Direct Booking Perks**: Guaranteed Best Rates, Welcome Signature Dawa Cocktail at Dawa Terrace, Flexible Direct Cancellation Policy (up to 48h before arrival), and Priority Early Check-In/Late Departure.

## Suites & Apartments
- **Luxury 1-Bedroom Apartment (95 m²)**: Handcrafted Swahili four-poster canopy king bed, en-suite bathroom, living lounge, full granite kitchen, private sea veranda. Ideal for couples and executives.
- **2-Bedroom Apartment (145 m²)**: King master suite + twin bedroom, 2 en-suite bathrooms, full family kitchen, expansive private balcony overlooking pools and creek. Ideal for families (up to 4 guests).
- **3-Bedroom Penthouse Suite (220 m²)**: Double-height vaulted ceilings, 3 en-suite bedrooms, rooftop sun terrace, spiral mahogany stairs, direct 270-degree creek panorama. Ideal for groups (up to 6 guests).

## Dining & Experiences
- **Tamarind Mombasa Restaurant**: Renowned as one of Africa's premier seafood destinations. Fresh mangrove crab, grilled prawns, lobster thermidor, and fresh catch of the day.
- **The Dawa Terrace**: Overwater open-air terrace bar home to the legendary original Kenyan "Dawa" cocktail. Tapas, sunset DJ sessions, and chill coastal vibes.
- **The Tamarind Dhow Cruise**: Historic wooden sailing dhows ("Nawalikoni" and "Babulkher") offering lunch and romantic candlelit dinner cruises along Tudor Creek past Fort Jesus with fresh charcoal-grilled seafood and live music.

## Private Transfers & Extras
- Private chauffeured airport and SGR transfers available on request (Executive Saloons, VIP Alphards, 4x4 Safari Landcruisers, Minivans).
- Event hosting: Cliffside weddings, sundowner soirées, and private dhow charters.
